interface.title: sgRNA Oligo Designer v1.0.0
interface.stage_of_work: experiment preparation — turning chosen guide sequences into orderable reagents and reference maps before cloning
interface.what_it_is_for: Converts a batch of 20-nt sgRNA target sequences plus an empty lentiviral vector into an IDT bulk oligo order form and a combined annotated GenBank file of every resulting plasmid construct.

data.note: First run used the bundled '⚡ Load example data' pipeline (4 sgRNAs, ipUSEPR vector, stuffer GAGACGTGACCGTCTCT). All later runs uploaded the provided test files: example_sgRNA_seqs.csv/.tsv/.xlsx, ipUSEPR.gb, lentiCRISPRv2.gb + lentiCRISPRv2_stuffer.fa, LentiCRISPRv2GFP.gb + LentiCRISPRv2GFP_stuffer.fa, ipUSEPR_stuffer.fa.

tree.general: Turn a list of chosen target sequences into reagents that can be ordered and into reference maps for checking the product
tree.specific: Design sense/antisense cloning oligos for a batch of sgRNAs, get an IDT bulk order form, and get an annotated GenBank map of each sgRNA-in-vector construct

features.name: One-click bundled example run
features.general: A single control loads a built-in dataset and runs the whole pipeline on it, so the shape of every output region can be seen before any of your own data is uploaded
features.specific: '⚡ Load example data' fills Step 1 and Step 2 with the bundled 4-sgRNA table, the ipUSEPR vector and its stuffer, and produces the Summary, the 8-row IDT order form preview and both download buttons in one press
steps: Press '⚡ Load example data' on a fresh session
Read the Summary line and the 8-row preview that appear without any upload
Press the two download buttons to see what the run hands back
Replace the example inputs with your own table and vector to continue from the same layout
serves_tasks: See the whole pipeline on a bundled dataset before committing your own data

features.name: Two-source sequence input with live source indicator
features.general: One value can be supplied either by typing it or by uploading a file; a status line always states which of the two sources is being used, or warns that neither is present, which gates a downstream optional output. The line reports presence only — it does not check that the supplied sequence is valid
features.specific: 'Stuffer sequence' text box and 'Or upload stuffer FASTA (.fa)' sit together under a status line that reads '✓ Using manually entered sequence', '✓ Using uploaded FASTA file' (upload wins) or '⚠ No stuffer — GenBank output disabled'; an unusable stuffer such as GAGACGTXNNN still shows '✓ Using manually entered sequence'
steps: Type the stuffer into the text box and read '✓ Using manually entered sequence'
Upload a .fa stuffer instead and watch the line flip to '✓ Using uploaded FASTA file' — the file takes precedence over the typed text
Start a fresh session with neither given and see '⚠ No stuffer — GenBank output disabled', which removes the GenBank half of the run
Press Run and confirm the Summary gains or loses the '| GenBank file ready' suffix accordingly
serves_tasks: Supply the backbone and the placeholder stretch it should swap out
Notice up front when an optional output cannot be produced at all

features.name: Advanced options panel driving the oligo preview table
features.general: A collapsible panel of text overrides — which table columns to read, and what fixed flanking strings to add — whose effect appears as rebuilt rows in the result table the next time the run control is pressed
features.specific: '⚙ Advanced options' holds sgRNA sequence/ID column names and the Sense prefix / Antisense prefix / Antisense suffix (CACCG / AAAC / C by default, tooltipped as BsmBI-style); the 'IDT order form preview' rows are rebuilt on Run, not while typing
steps: Expand '⚙ Advanced options' and hover a ⓘ to read what each default is for
Change the sense prefix, antisense prefix and antisense suffix to another cloning system's overhangs
Press Run and compare the preview rows against the previous ones
Rename the sequence column to something absent and press Run to see the error listing the columns the file actually has
Restore the real column name and re-run
serves_tasks: Adapt the flanking bases added to each oligo so they match a different cloning system
Point the tool at the right columns when your spreadsheet uses other headings

features.name: Run summary + preview table + paired downloads
features.general: A single Run produces a one-line count of what was made, a scrollable table of every produced item, and two download buttons; re-running refreshes all three regions in place
features.specific: Summary ('Processed 4 sgRNA sequences → 8 oligos (4 sense + 4 antisense) | GenBank file ready'), the IDT order form preview (Name / Sequence / Scale / Purification), and 'Download IDT Order Form' (.xlsx) + 'Download Combined GenBank' (.gb)
steps: Press Run and read the Summary count line
Scan the preview table to check each sgRNA produced a _s and an _a oligo with the expected flanks
Download the .xlsx order form and the combined .gb
Re-run after changing an input and watch the same three regions refresh in place
serves_tasks: Run the calculation and read back how many items were produced
Read the produced items row by row before ordering
Download annotated maps of each expected product

features.name: Summary suffix as the pass/fail readout for the optional second output
features.general: The run's one-line summary doubles as the only verdict on whether an optional secondary output could be built; its presence or absence is the whole signal, and the failure carries no message of its own while the download button for that output stays enabled
features.specific: '| GenBank file ready' at the end of the Summary is the only sign that the stuffer was located in the vector; a mismatched or unusable stuffer produces the same 8 oligos with the suffix quietly gone, no warning text, and 'Download Combined GenBank' still serving the previous successful run's file
steps: Upload a candidate vector .gb and give the stuffer it is supposed to contain
Press Run and read the tail of the Summary line
Swap in another vector/stuffer pair and re-run to compare backbones
Note that a failing pair shows no error at all — only the missing suffix
Download the combined .gb only after seeing the suffix, since the button can hand back a stale file
serves_tasks: Confirm the chosen backbone contains the placeholder the strategy replaces, before ordering

features.name: Errors reported in two places at once
features.general: A failed run is announced twice: as a transient notice at the edge of the window and as red text that replaces each result region, so the reason survives after the notice disappears
features.specific: A bad column name or unsupported file type raises a red toast and, at the same time, red 'Error:' lines under both 'Summary' and 'IDT order form preview'; the preview table disappears while both download buttons remain
steps: Press Run with a wrong sgRNA sequence column name and read the red toast
Scroll to Summary and the IDT order form preview and read the same message inline
Fix the input and re-run to see both regions return to normal content
serves_tasks: Have bad or unreadable input rejected with a message instead of silently producing junk

features.name: Output naming controls for the construct map
features.general: Two free-text fields rename the produced records and the downloaded file, with a stated fallback when left blank
features.specific: 'Vector name (optional)' (default: vector filename stem) and 'Combined .gb filename stem' feed each record's LOCUS/ACCESSION/VERSION/DEFINITION and the download filename
steps: Type a vector name and a filename stem
Press Run and download the combined GenBank
Open it and confirm records read '<vector name>_<sgRNA id>' and the file is named '<stem>.gb'
Clear the vector name and re-run to see it fall back to the uploaded file's stem
serves_tasks: Choose the names that will appear on the produced map file and its filename

screens_never_reached: The red error toast shown when Run is pressed with no sgRNA table — it renders clipped at the bottom edge of the window and is absent from the accessibility tree, so its wording could not be read (screens/025.webp); the same error is readable inline once a different failure occurs (screens/020.webp).
No other named views exist: the app is a single page with one sidebar and one results column.
not_done: Could not exercise the per-sequence validators for wrong length, non-ACGT characters, duplicate sgRNA_ids or an accidentally included PAM: only well-formed sgRNA tables are available as test files and the browser cannot author a malformed one. Only file-level and column-level validation could be demonstrated.

The web app would not have shown most of it anyway: per the code, the length and PAM warnings print only to the server's stderr, the duplicate-ID check exists only in the command-line tool (sgrna_oligo_designer.py:776), and only a non-ACGT guide would surface on screen. So the plan's 'check each guide before ordering' goal is only partly served by this interface.

The backbone error messages the README documents ('Stuffer not found on either strand', 'found N times', 'palindromic') never reach the web user: app.py:446 catches them and only drops the '| GenBank file ready' suffix. The failure is therefore silent, and 'Download Combined GenBank' still serves the previous successful run's file, so it is easy to miss.
Could not read the contents of the downloaded IDT .xlsx (reported as binary); its correctness was judged from the on-screen preview table only.

Could not clear an already-uploaded file from a file input — there is no clear/X control, so the only way back to the 'no stuffer' / 'no table' state was reloading the page, which starts a new session.

Display controls (header 'Toggle dark / light mode', 'Toggle sidebar' to widen the preview table) were pressed and work as labelled (screens/029.webp, screens/030.webp), but they are button-level chrome rather than a stage of the work, so they are recorded here as a note instead of as a task.

open_fixes: Per-guide validation (non-ACGT bases, length other than 20 nt, an included PAM, duplicate sgRNA_ids) still needs a new run with deliberately malformed sgRNA tables authored outside the browser; only the non-ACGT case is expected to appear on screen, and that expectation itself needs checking.

The hidden backbone messages ('Stuffer not found on either strand', 'found N times', 'palindromic') were read from the code, not seen; a run that can read the server log would be needed to confirm they fire where the UI only drops the suffix.

What happens to the two outputs downstream — uploading the .xlsx to IDT's bulk oligo entry and opening the .gb in SnapGene or Benchling to inspect the insert — happens outside this tool and would need a separate exploration to document.

The wording of the red toast raised by pressing Run with nothing loaded is still unread: it renders clipped and is absent from the accessibility tree, so it needs a run at a different window size or with log access.

Clearing an uploaded file without reloading the page was never achieved; if the interface gains a clear control it should be retried, since the 'clear both' path through f1 is currently only observable from a fresh session.
